title: 第19章 这里有人养猫吗第20章 烂借口
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
温郗抿了抿唇，感到有些压力山大，但她实在饿的不行了，选择先去食堂啃俩馒头。
温郗溜达到食堂，打了两盘荤菜，一盘素菜，美美吃完后准备再返回典籍司，却又在鸡腿窗口看见了那个神色冷漠的少年。
温言又打了两个鸡腿。
温郗歪头，这人这么喜欢鸡腿呢？
但就吃两个也吃不饱啊？
感受到温郗的视线，温言缓缓抬眸，视线落在了温郗身上，但不过一眼便好似看到了什么脏东西一样立刻移开视线。
他甚至又皱了皱眉。
温郗：……
哥们，你对她的敌意是不是来的有些莫名其妙了。
就因为她没按照他们的安排献祭？
温言接过鸡腿转身大步离去，温郗缓步跟在他身后。
两人在大门口默契地各奔东西。
在典籍司看了一下午的书后，温郗拿了两个馒头回宿舍继续修炼，奈何刚运转了三个周天，她就皱眉停止了灵力运转。
温郗：……
好饿，怎么这么饿。
饿到心慌。
她已经把两个馒头全吃光了，可还是觉得好饿。
温郗没办法，又跑了一趟食堂，拿了五个馒头回来，可还没到半夜，她就一口一口地吃完了，饥饿的感觉一点都没缓解。
温郗眨眨眼，逐渐意识到似乎不是她的胃在饿。
而是——

她的灵根在“饿”。
温郗皱眉，这里的灵力似乎满足不了她的修炼，她需要更多的灵力，更浓郁的灵力。
她心下有些犹豫，以宿舍楼里的环境显然会限制她的修炼，她的时间又很紧……
温郗不自觉想起了昨天的林子，那里明明就就是新弟子允许活动的范围，可昨天那个大佬又不知道是什么底细……
温郗眯起眼睛，有了决定。
算了，再去一趟。
反正是在青云道院里，她作为最有潜力的新生，身上的价值不用多说。
虽然温郗上辈子没怎么出过病房，但也知道“学校”对“学生”都是会优先保护的——更不用说青云道院这种培养修士的门派。
她今天绝对安安静静，一点动静都不会发出来，她就不信那大佬还能嫌她吵。
有本事就打死她！（纯口嗨）
只要打不死，她爬也要爬到那边去修炼，她的灵根都快饿死了。
——————
温郗弯着腰鬼鬼祟祟地又摸到了未央林，在林子入口随便找了个地方开始运转灵力。
眨眼就是半个时辰。
content_en:
Wen Xi pursed her lips, feeling a little stressed out, but she was really hungry, so she chose to go to the cafeteria to eat two steamed buns first.
Wen Xi walked to the cafeteria and ordered two plates of meat dishes and one plate of vegetarian dishes. After finishing the meal, he was about to return to the Classics Department, but he saw the indifferent young man at the chicken leg window again.
Wen Yan hit two more chicken drumsticks.
Wen Xi tilted his head, why does this person like chicken legs so much?
But you can’t feel full even if you only eat two?
Feeling Wen Xi's gaze, Wen Yan slowly raised his eyes and landed on Wen Xi, but after just one glance, he immediately looked away as if he had seen something dirty.
He even frowned again.
Wen Xi:......
Brother, your hostility towards her is a bit out of nowhere.
Just because she didn't sacrifice according to their arrangements?
Wen Yan took the chicken leg, turned around, and strode away, with Wen Xi slowly following behind him.
The two of them went their separate ways in a tacit understanding at the gate.
After reading a book in the Classics Department all afternoon, Wen Xi took two steamed buns and went back to the dormitory to continue practicing. However, after just three weeks of operation, she frowned and stopped the operation of her spiritual power.
Wen Xi:......
So hungry, why are you so hungry?
Hungry to the point of panic.
She had already eaten both steamed buns, but she still felt very hungry.
Wen Xi had no choice but to go to the cafeteria again and came back with five steamed buns. But before midnight, she finished them one bite at a time, and her hunger did not ease at all.
Wen Xi blinked and gradually realized that it wasn't her stomach that was hungry.
But——
Her spiritual roots are "hungry".
Wen Xi frowned. It seemed that the spiritual power here could not satisfy her cultivation. She needed more spiritual power, richer spiritual power.
She was a little hesitant. The environment in the dormitory building would obviously restrict her cultivation, and her time was very tight...
Wen Xi couldn't help but think of the forest yesterday. It was clearly the area where new disciples were allowed to move, but the big boss yesterday didn't know what the details were...
Wen Xi narrowed his eyes and made a decision.
Forget it, go there again.
Anyway, in Qingyun Taoist Academy, as the most promising new student, her value goes without saying.
Although Wen Xi had never been out of the ward in his previous life, he also knew that the "school" would give priority to "students" - not to mention Qingyun Taoist School, a sect that cultivates monks.
She was absolutely quiet today and wouldn't make any noise. She didn't believe that the boss could still find her noisy.
If you can, beat her to death! (Pure oral pleasure)
As long as she couldn't be beaten to death, she would crawl over there to practice. Her spiritual roots were almost starving to death.
——————
Wen Xi bent down and sneakily touched Weiyang Forest again, found a random place at the entrance of the forest and started to use his spiritual power.
It takes half an hour to blink.
